rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the creation of the `main.py` and `streamlit_app.py` files. These files will provide a command-line interface and a user-facing web application for the `gbad_core` library.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Context:** The refactored `gbad_core` library needs user-friendly interfaces to make it accessible to both developers and non-technical users.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `main.py`:** - Create a new file `main.py` in the root of the repository. - Use a library like `argparse` or `click` to create a command-line interface that uses the `gbad_core.pipeline.Pipeline` class to run the conversion process. 2. **Create `streamlit_app.py`:** - Create a new file `streamlit_app.py` in the root of the repository. - Use the `streamlit` library to create a web application that allows users to: - Upload Draw.io and CSV files. - Configure the conversion process. - Run the pipeline and download the resulting N-Quads file.
